claims.text: OpenAI's Aug 19 post offers Zero Data Retention for eligible API frontier-model customers: prompts/responses not retained after processing.
The same post previews Private Safety Processing: automated cross-interaction pattern detection emitting narrow activity-type/severity signals without accessing content, tested with early customers.
Named early direction supporters in the post include Glean, Databricks, Abridge, and Microsoft.
